frozen_preprocessing.source_grid: Read each full X/Y/Z grid as little-endian float32 and reshape C-order to 2184x156x156.
frozen_preprocessing.rectilinear_verification: Derive x=X[:,0,0], y=Y[0,:,0], z=Z[0,0,:]; require each full grid to equal its broadcast axis within 8*float32-epsilon*max(axis_abs,1), require finite strictly monotone axes, and reverse both coordinate and density axes when decreasing.
frozen_preprocessing.source_density: Read each exact-roster RHO file as little-endian float32, reshape C-order to 2184x156x156, and require finite strictly positive values.
frozen_preprocessing.spatial_selection: Use the complete verified source-coordinate bounding box; no truth-dependent crop, registration, flame-front tracking, temporal exclusion, or manual ROI.
frozen_preprocessing.target_coordinate_rule: Float64 linspace including every verified source-axis endpoint, followed by deterministic float64 trilinear interpolation with bounds_error=true and no extrapolation.
frozen_preprocessing.support: Apply the same one-voxel outer-boundary zero support as v235-v243.
frozen_preprocessing.gauge: Subtract the spatial mean over the supported interior before restoring the zero support boundary.
frozen_preprocessing.snapshot_order: Use snapshot_ids_in_order and snapshot_times_seconds_in_order exactly; do not infer a contiguous ID range.

frozen_geometry_and_canonical_adapter.camera_selection: For each frozen rig, take exactly the first nine stable camera IDs in its already frozen twelve-camera order, then sort those nine IDs in ascending ASCII order before operator construction.
frozen_geometry_and_canonical_adapter.observation_transform: Map each source-order contiguous 16x16x2 camera block to its stable camera ID and concatenate in canonical ID order without arithmetic or dtype conversion.
frozen_geometry_and_canonical_adapter.permutation_requirement: The original and reversed labeled camera rosters must canonicalize to identical stable-ID tuples and byte-identical observations; all fields, residuals, metrics, calls, and cache audit values must then be exactly equal.

solver_and_arms.common_frame_zero: For every rig, run zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 on the first Case 19 frame, use that exact run as the scored frame-zero value for every arm, and initialize the fixed-rank FIFO cache from its sixteen field/projected directions.
